meta.title: Bilibili
meta.description: Full Bilibili integration for DeepSeek Harness: 20 bili_* tools for search, videos and parts, creators, comments, danmaku, ranking, popular, trending searches, bangumi, live rooms, subtitles, play URLs, personal history/favorites/follows/dynamics after QR sign-in, and video/audio download; 10 tool cards, Settings → Bilibili, and a Trending / Search / Details drawer opened from the sidebar foot. The panel route reads public data only; personal data and downloads go through the tools.

settings.label: Bilibili
settings.title: Bilibili integration
settings.intro: This plugin connects Bilibili to DeepSeek Harness: 20 bili_* tools cover search, videos and parts, creators, comments, danmaku, ranking, popular, bangumi, live, subtitles, play URLs and video/audio download; after sign-in it reads watch history, favorites, follows and dynamics. It ships tool cards, this settings page and a Bilibili browsing panel at the sidebar foot.

login.title: Sign-in and runtime status
login.ffmpegMissing: Missing (downloads fall back to one media stream)
login.refreshHint: This page is read-only: status comes from the panel route /dsh-bilibili/api/status; reload the page or press Retry to refresh.

scan.title: QR sign-in in three steps
scan.step1: 1. Call bili_login with action=start in the conversation (the default action is status): it generates a QR code and returns the image with the tool result.
scan.step2: 2. Open Scan in the Bilibili mobile app, scan the code and confirm the sign-in on the phone.
scan.step3: 3. Ask the agent to poll with bili_login action=poll; when state=ok the cookie is written to the BILI_COOKIE credential and history, favorites, follows and dynamics become readable.
scan.note: Sign out with bili_login action=logout, or configure the BILI_COOKIE credential directly in the profile to skip the QR flow. The plugin never stores an account password.

config.title: Configuration keys
config.hint: Configure the bilibili row in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Configuration values apply after a reload; source code changes need a DSH restart.

keys.cookieEnv: Credential name (credentials ref / environment variable name) for the cookie; a successful sign-in writes to this name.
keys.maxListedItems: Maximum items a list tool returns per call (1-200).
keys.attachImages: Attach covers, avatars and the sign-in QR code to tool results as images; when off only links and paths return.
keys.ffmpegPath: Path to the ffmpeg executable; empty auto-detects from PATH.
keys.maxDownloadMb: Size cap for one download in MiB (1-51200).
keys.panelEnabled: Register the Bilibili button and browsing panel at the sidebar foot.
keys.publicRoute: Register the panel route /dsh-bilibili/api (public data only); when off the panel is unavailable.
keys.cacheTtlMs: In-memory cache lifetime for panel routes and tool responses in milliseconds (1000-3600000).
keys.wbiCacheTtlMs: Cache lifetime for WBI signing keys in milliseconds (60000-86400000).

limits.title: Known limits and copyright
limits.risk: Risk control (BILI_RISK_CONTROL / -352 / -412 / -799) cannot be bypassed: degrade or retry later as the hint says, and never hammer the endpoint.
limits.auth: Personal-data tools return BILI_AUTH_REQUIRED while signed out; run bili_login with action=start or configure BILI_COOKIE.
limits.rate: The panel reads public endpoints only and may be briefly rate-limited; the Host keeps a 30-second memory cache, so wait before refreshing again.
limits.download: Downloads merge audio and video with ffmpeg; without ffmpeg only one stream is available, and paid or restricted content cannot be unlocked.
limits.copyright: Downloaded content is for personal offline study and backup only: do not redistribute it or use it commercially. Data comes from public Bilibili APIs; follow the Bilibili terms of service.
limits.panel: This page is read-only and cannot change configuration; every action runs through the bili_* tools. The panel never reads personal data.
